name: Tamali Neogi

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Tamali Neogi is a poet, fiction writer and literary scholar associated with the English department at Gushkara College in West Bengal. Her books include “Woman of Patashpur”, “Moments” and the poetry collection “Winged Monologues”. Her scholarship on women’s writing and literary representation accompanies a creative practice that moves between remembered lives, ethical questions and imaginative transformation.

“A Converted Rose” gathers the remnants of a life through flowers, letters and family memories. “Golden Butterfly” uses trees, roots and resin to consider vulnerability and the work of growing beneath the surface. In “Fallen Leaf”, epic heroes enter an argument about the ethics of victory. The poem’s uneasy questions ask whether accepted stories of good and evil can withstand scrutiny.
